title: Cost of Living
scope: This ledger ranks states on BEA all-items regional price parities for 2024 (United States = 100), and also reports the 2024 component RPPs for goods, housing, utilities, and other services. Tariff, defense-impact, and fiscal-dependency measures are Pioneer products and stay pending until those methods are in the repo.
exclusions: Does not cover a household budget calculator or advice about moving. Tariff, defense, and fiscal-dependency measures are pending: decline those. Do not substitute a Census dump for Pioneer's method.
heritage: Formerly Cost of Living, State Dependency, Tariff Impacts, and Defense Impact
vintage_note: Rebuilt Aug 15, 2026 from BEA SARPP_STATE_2008_2024, LineCode 1 (RPPs: All items). U.S. 2024 equals 100. Tariff, defense, and state-dependency indexes remain pending. Later views compiled Aug 15, 2026 are stored under derived.secondary. Later views compiled Aug 15, 2026 are stored under derived.secondary.

q: Regional price parities by state from the Bureau of Economic Analysis.
lead: The BEA all-items regional price parity for the United States is 100 by construction in 2024 (SRC-619-01). Massachusetts was 105.8, rank 7 of 51 when states are ordered from highest price level to lowest (derived, SRC-619-01). On the 2024 component RPPs, Massachusetts housing was 128.1 versus 100 nationally, rank 4 of 51 (derived, SRC-619-02). Goods were 98.8 and utilities 152.1 (SRC-619-02). Tariff, defense, and fiscal-dependency measures remain Pioneer methods and are not in this ledger.
